help.title: Help center
help.account_body: Your company creates your account from the web dashboard. Sign in with your email or phone number and the password your manager gave you. If it is a temporary password, the app asks you to choose a new one.
help.password_body: Ask your manager to reset it from the dashboard. You will get a temporary password.
help.network_body: The app needs the internet to record each operation. Without a network a banner shows at the top of the screen; try again when it is back. Trying again never records an operation twice.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.data_body: Your name, your role and what you record at work: sales, orders, deliveries, payments, visits and stock movements, with the time of each operation and the device used.
privacy.location_body: Your precise position is recorded only when you save a sale, a payment, a visit or a delivery, to check that you were at the client. The app never tracks you in the background. You can refuse the permission; the operation is then recorded without a position, following your company's rules. (Law 18-07 on the protection of natural persons in the processing of personal data)
privacy.controller_body: Your company (the wholesaler you work for) is responsible for processing this data. It is used only to run its business; it is never sold or used for advertising.
privacy.rights_body: You can ask your company to see or correct your data.
